# Agreement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Agreement>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/agreements`](../../slices/agreements.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A mutual understanding between two or more agents that creates obligations or rights, reified as a relator connecting its parties.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Employment Contract

- **Source:** [`slices/core/agreements/examples/employment-contract.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/agreements/examples/employment-contract.ttl)

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: an agreement as a relator. A gmeow:Agreement (here a
# gmeow:Contract, the legally-enforceable specialization) is a gufo:Relator that
# binds its parties via gmeow:hasParty — the agreement IS the relationship, not a
# property of either party. It bears a structured gmeow:AgreementName (an
# Appellation, so multilingual co-equal titles are first-class). Other relators
# can be gmeow:foundedOn it: the employment Membership below exists BECAUSE of the
# contract, so its grounding is recorded rather than assumed.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/agreements/> .

ex:contractName a gmeow:AgreementName ;
    gmeow:fullName "Acme Robotics — Reyes Employment Agreement (2026)"@en .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the binding object itself — the reified relationship between two or more agents that creates obligations or rights, and the thing on which other relators ([`Membership`](gmeow-Membership.md), [`KinRelationship`](gmeow-KinRelationship.md)) are founded via [`gmeow:foundedOn`](../properties/gmeow-foundedOn.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the teleological bond of being committed toward someone (that is the teleology module's [`gmeow:Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md)) and for the agreement's title or document; mint a [`gmeow:Contract`](gmeow-Contract.md) when legal enforceability is the point.

### How to use

- Mint one [`Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md) relator, bind every bound agent with [`gmeow:hasParty`](../properties/gmeow-hasParty.md), and link the per-direction teleological promises as [`gmeow:Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md) moments; ground dependent relators on it with [`gmeow:foundedOn`](../properties/gmeow-foundedOn.md) rather than re-stating the parties.

### Examples

- ex:partnership a [`gmeow:Agreement`](gmeow-Agreement.md); [`gmeow:hasParty`](../properties/gmeow-hasParty.md) ex:lillith, ex:vendor.
